_what: Everything the kiosk sends Home Assistant, declared ONCE. The proxy (rootfs/usr/bin/supervisor-proxy.py) builds its non-owner allow-lists from this file; the app (src/ha/haCommands.ts) imports it; tests/oracles/ha_commands.mjs fails when the app sends a type or domain not listed here. A new command is added HERE, and nowhere else.
_camera: Every command that opens a camera's picture; each also needs the viewCameras capability.
_serviceDomains: The domains a kiosk button calls a service in (light.turn_on, scene.turn_on, …).
_homeassistantServices: homeassistant.* also holds system services (restart, stop, set_location…); only these.
_readDomains: The entity domains a non-owner session may READ at all — states, state_changed events, history, the logbook and the entity registry are narrowed to these by the proxy. Everything the kiosk draws or scans: ENTITY_DOMAINS (src/types/ha.types.ts) plus sun, scene and weather. A person, a tracker, an alarm panel, a calendar never leaves the add-on for a guest or ops session; camera states go only to a profile that may view cameras.
